title: UAAP: Adamson back to winning, adds to UE's woes

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Adamson bounced back and kept University of the East searching for its first win with a 71-64 victory in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Mall of Asia Arena on Sunday. The Soaring Falcons, who recovered from a lopsided loss to National University four days ago, improved to 3-2 and sent the Red Warriors to their sixth straight loss. “We weren’t really surprised with how they played in the second half because I always remind the players that UE is due for a win,” coach Nash Racela said.
